data.title: Formula Race Cars and Grand Prix Circuit
data.summary: Nine open-wheel formula race cars from the 1950s to today with modular circuit straights, corners, chicanes and banking, kerbs, gravel traps, tyre walls, pit lane equipment and venue furniture.
data.description: Metre-scale original open-wheel motorsport family with named wheels, explicit circuit interfaces and assembled hairpin/pit-lane demonstration. Static CC0 models.
